text:
ash: quick thread — naming + accessibility for the vectors export and compact preview toggle. two quick asks: stable filename pattern & keyboard SR behavior when toggling density.
nina: filename pattern: `rerank-<run_id>-<model>-<YYYYMMDD>.csv` — predictable for automation. optional suffix `-provenance.jsonl` when full export selected.
pal: accessibility: when user toggles compact mode, announce via polite aria-live: 'Compact view enabled; interactive targets preserved'. keep checkbox and kebab at 44px even in compact view.
rook: copy tweak: change export menu item from 'Download with provenance' to 'Export results (include run details)'. SR helper: 'Includes model id, run id, and prompt hash when enabled'.
ash: dev note: default CSV minimal header `vector_id,score,rank`; JSONL includes run metadata and prompt only if opt-in. backend will add `export_signature`.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist reminder — focus trap in export modal, aria-sort on columns, and throttled aria-live batching for score updates.
nina: small UI: show 'Compact' toggle in header next to pagination. default off.
pal: can someone mock frames? nina can you?
ash: yep. will follow up with figma frames + export filename examples. thanks all.
